description: One $2,000 award a year for a sophomore or junior with a military, ROTC, veteran or AFCEA-member connection.
eligibility_text: Undergraduates must be at the sophomore or junior level. Must maintain a minimum 2.8 overall GPA. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Must be enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university, pursuing a STEM-related major that supports the mission of AFCEA. Must meet at least one of: currently serving in the U.S. Armed Forces or enrolled in an ROTC program; an honorably discharged veteran; or a direct descendant of an AFCEA member or an honorably discharged U.S. service member.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. The service/AFCEA-descendant connection is an either/or, but every branch of it is a military or AFCEA tie, so military_family is true. Page status on 2026-09-19: 'Applications closed!'. The page publishes no application deadline; 'no later than May 1, 2026' is the mailed-documents date for the closed cycle, recorded as cycle.deadline_month 5.
